messages:
nina: quick sync on API keys UX. areas: revoke/rotate CTA labels, keyboard focus, empty-state messaging for non-admins, and badge contrast. here's mock: https://redwood.design/keys-ux-v3

harry: Revoke modal uses 'Confirm' which is ambiguous. Suggest 'Revoke key' (destructive red) on the right, 'Cancel' on the left. Keep consistent with other destructive modals.

sam: Agree. For rotate flow, product wants it to be a single click. engineering says staged rollout. UI idea: single CTA that triggers hidden steps; show progress modal with friendly step names. Keep cancel prior to swap only. Announce each step via aria-live.

aria-bot: accessibility-scan: missing aria-live for step changes. Low contrast on .perm-badge. Missing focus return after modal close.

nina: empty state: use explicit CTA 'Create an API key'. If user lacks permission, CTA disabled with tooltip: 'Admin permissions required'. Also add microcopy: 'Keys are created by org admins for centralized security'.

harry: bulk revoke: require confirmation for >4 keys. Show a warning checkbox and for admins ask to type org id to proceed. Bulk rotate: lighter confirmation.

sam: Add small 'Dedicated' badge for keys with dedicated assignments. When revoking show inline banner: 'Key attached to Dedicated pool X — revoking may interrupt traffic.' with 'Show affected services' toggle.

aria-bot: attached selectors: .perm-badge, .modal-step, .empty-cta. Suggested fixes in doc comments.

nina: will update mocks and re-run a11y scan. thanks.
